ztwvsmy4.variantName: My Christmas 4ft Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with LED Lights - 120cm
ztwvsmy4.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of a snowy Christmas into your home with this 4ft artificial Christmas tree, featuring 320 lifelike branch tips made from a PE and PVC blend. The realistic green foliage is enhanced with flocked snow accents to create a winter-inspired appearance, while the sturdy branches provide support for your favourite Christmas decorations. The integrated lights offer warm white and cool white options, with nine lighting effects to suit different festive settings. An included remote control allows you to switch between lighting modes conveniently. The fully hinged construction makes assembly and branch shaping straightforward, and the tree can be dismantled into four sections for easy storage after the festive season. A sturdy metal stand provides reliable stability, making this tree a charming centrepiece for homes, offices and other indoor festive displays. Specifications: Made from PE and PVC with 320 lifelike branch tips and flocked snow accents. Features integrated lights with warm white and cool white settings, nine lighting effects and an included remote control. Fully hinged construction with four dismantlable sections and a sturdy metal stand. Dimensions: Height: 4ft (approximately 122cm). Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

tm7n4bpg.baseName: COSTWAY 6.5 FT Pre-Lit Pencil Artificial Christmas Tree-Green
tm7n4bpg.variantName: COSTWAY 6.5 FT Pre-Lit Pencil Artificial Christmas Tree-Green
tm7n4bpg.sourceDescription: This tree is made to brighten holiday decorating with a slim shape that fits smaller rooms while still offering a rich seasonal look. warm white lights are already installed, so setup feels simpler and your space looks festive sooner. Lights on or lights off is up to you! The hinged structure helps each section open smoothly, and the folding metal stand adds dependable support during the season and easier storage afterward. Built for repeated holiday use, this tree uses quality PVC branch tips that are flame-retardant, smell-free, non-allergic and resistant to fading over time. With branch tips, its layered greenery gives it a more natural presence indoors. Note: Ornaments are not included. Warm Seasonal Shine: This lighted Christmas tree comes pre-lit with warm white LED lights that cast a cozy glow across the room. It creates an inviting holiday atmosphere without the time and mess of hanging separate light strands. Premium PVC Materials: Made with high-quality materials, this artificial Christmas tree comes with flame-retardant branches and is fully smell-free as well as non-allergic to offer safe holiday decoration. Additionally, its anti-fading foliage keeps vibrant year-round, enabling stable and long-lasting seasonal reuse. Layered Branch Beauty: With branch tips, this realistic Christmas tree presents dense layered foliage. Moreover, it maintains an evergreen look, giving your indoor decoration a natural and polished holiday presence. Faster Setup Design: This pencil Christmas tree features a section design for easy assembly. Meanwhile, it comes with hinged branches that automatically spread out to the designated space. What’s more, folding metal stand ensures convenient storage and single pin simplifies installation. Space-Saving Holiday Shape: Designed as a slim Christmas tree, it brings lifelike seasonal charm in a pencil shape. The slim Xmas tree fits beautifully in apartments, corners, entryways and other smaller spaces without overwhelming the room. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

rnr2cf0x.baseName: Walplus Pop-up Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
rnr2cf0x.variantName: Walplus Pop-up Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
rnr2cf0x.sourceDescription: Our pop-up string artificial Christmas tree, with 150 pcs LEDs, creates a nice and unique atmosphere in the soon approaching Christmas. This lovely Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is lightweight and can collapse down into a tiny shape for easy storage. The holiday decoration can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Additionally, It can be used both indoors and sheltered outdoors. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Total height: 180 cm Tree diameter: 60 cm With 150 pcs LEDs Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 1 W Easily pops up in seconds USB interface Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

rn0zxnbp.baseName: COSTWAY 6FT Pre-Lit Pencil Slim Christmas Tree With Branch Tips-Green
rn0zxnbp.variantName: COSTWAY 6FT Pre-Lit Pencil Slim Christmas Tree With Branch Tips-Green
rn0zxnbp.sourceDescription: This pre-lit Christmas tree combines textured greenery with soft illumination in a slender profile. Standing 1.8M tall, it combines 346 full branch tips with pine needles and PVC foliage for varied shades, textures, and added dimension. Across the greenery, 150 warm white LED lights cast a soothing radiance, complemented by a slim pencil shape that gives this skinny Christmas tree graceful height with minimal floor space. Made from premium PVC, the foliage is flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic for added reassurance around children and pets. This artificial Xmas tree works well in homes, offices, schools, stores, themed parties, festive celebrations, family gatherings, and other seasonal settings. Full & Layered Greenery: This 1.8M artificial Christmas tree combines 346 verdant branch tips for plentiful foliage and a well-filled profile. Plus, it includes 2 types of leaves with different shades and textures (pine needles, PVC leaves), adding visual depth and natural variation throughout the tree. Built-in Seasonal Shine: This pre-lit artificial Christmas tree comes pre-strung with 150 warm white LED lights, so the tree looks beautifully illuminated right out of the box. The soft glow helps create a cozy seasonal atmosphere. Dependable Material Build: Crafted with premium PVC leaves, this slim Xmas tree offers flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic properties for reassuring seasonal enjoyment. It provides added peace of mind around children, pets, family members, and guests. Space Saving Tree Style: The refined silhouette of this skinny Christmas tree makes it a smart option for compact spaces that still deserve festive charm. Its tall, slender shape works especially well in apartments, offices, schools, stores, and corners that need seasonal decoration. Space-Smart Celebration Accent: This lighted pencil Christmas tree is equipped with a foldable base and 3-section tree trunk, making setup and off-season storage a breeze. Beyond Christmas Day, it also complements themed parties, festive celebrations, and family gatherings. Note: The decorations are not included. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL
